items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Yeah, now we supplied in the district together with Piron. So, at the casino, and Wade Whaley, Black Pete, myself, and Piron, and four of us.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Wade Whaley, the Claremanist?
Oh, man. Yeah. Oh, I like to see Wade.
We couldn't find him in California. Fess and I tried to find him and already nobody knows where he is. I believe Wade.
